analyzed_vuln.description: Out-of-bounds read in gvar offset array due to missing bounds check on index `i` in `gvar::get_offset()`. The function directly indexes `get_short_offset_array()[i]` / `get_long_offset_array()[i]` without validating `i <= glyphCount`. With malformed gvar metadata, callers (notably `get_glyph_var_data_bytes(glyph)` using `get_offset(glyph+1)`) can request an index past the allocated `(glyphCount+1)` offsets, causing a 2-byte heap OOB read when decoding HBUINT16.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered by a crafted variable font parsed by hb-draw-fuzzer that reaches glyph extents computation (`hb_ot_get_glyph_extents` -> glyf points -> gvar delta application). The font must include a gvar table that passes shallow sanitize enough to be used, but has inconsistent glyph indexing/offset-array assumptions so `get_glyph_var_data_bytes()` calls `get_offset(glyph+1)` with an out-of-range index. In short-offset mode this causes the observed ASan read in `BEInt<unsigned short>::operator unsigned short()`.
